review.notes: Triage coverage: full-document structural scan (zero code fences in the OCR Markdown; all 30 figure captions and 25 table captions present, none duplicated) plus a machine page-text diff of all 75 physical pages using normalized 4-gram containment; pages below 0.96 containment (8, 12, 13, 15-17, 21, 24, 30, 32, 37, 39, 46, 52) were inspected individually and every missing run was resolved as figure-internal axis/chart/table text or LaTeX-equivalent math, except the repairs patched below. Physical pages 28 and 59 were rendered and visually inspected to confirm the two structural defect classes; physical page 37 text confirmed the prose spacing '800 1080p videos'. Line-level greps found no spaced digits, no <think> tag damage, no escaped-underscore defects (h264\_nvenc, seq\_len render correctly as underscores), and all reference URLs match the PDF text exactly. Not line-by-line: the full prose of every page was machine-scanned rather than read word by word; figure-internal evaluation percentages on physical pages 46 and 52 exist only inside the embedded figure images, which is expected.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.28 shows 'Pair Encoding (BPE) (Gage, 1994).' as an ordinary body paragraph at the top of the page, continuing the Sec. 5.2.1 sentence '...trained on a large corpus of text with algorithms such as Byte' that ends physical p.27. The OCR promoted this page-break continuation fragment to a level-2 heading; the patch only removes the spurious '## ' prefix and leaves the sentence text unchanged.

Rendered physical p.59 (Appendix A.1 Core Contributors) prints every contribution-area name, including 'Data Curation', as a bulleted list item; OCR promoted this item to a level-2 heading. The patch strips only the spurious '## ' prefix, preserving the OCR bullet character.
